name: search_norwegian_companies
description: Find Norwegian companies by industry (SN2025), municipality, postal code, legal form, employees, founding or registration date, website pattern and revenue range.

name: get_norwegian_company
description: Get a full company profile by organisation number, with contact details, CEO, board, auditor and the latest revenue and profit.

name: get_norwegian_company_financials
description: Get up to three years of company or group accounts, with growth, margin and equity ratio.

name: get_norwegian_company_group
description: Get the corporate group (konsern), with the top parent and every subsidiary's ownership share.

name: find_norwegian_industry_codes
description: Find SN2025 industry codes from Norwegian or English words.

name: find_norwegian_company_websites
description: Find verified websites for one to five companies, plus the platform each runs on (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Wix…).
